prs.title: fix: buffer stdio server writes during progress notifications
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both PRs modify the write_stream memory object buffer size in stdio_server(). PR #2215 makes both read/write buffer sizes configurable (defaulting to 0), while PR #2654 hardcodes write_stream to 1 to fix a specific deadlock when a handler tries to enqueue its final response while stdout_writer is still flushing a progress notification. prs.cluster_pick_reason: PR #2654 targets a concrete, reproducible deadlock (handler blocked trying to send final response while stdout_writer holds the write stream) and ships a test using BlockingStdout to prove the fix.
